scenes.title: EBO SE 2 or EBO Air 2?
scenes.say: Enabot's two best selling pet robots. The EBO SE 2 for one sixty nine ninety nine, or the EBO Air 2 for one ninety nine. What's the difference?

scenes.title: Both roll, film and play
scenes.say: Both are small 2K cameras you drive around your home, with night vision, a built in laser for your cat, and the same four to seven hour battery.

scenes.title: Newer and cheaper
scenes.say: The SE 2 adds Wi Fi 6, a feather toy and a pet fun patrol mode, and Enabot includes a thirty two gigabyte SD card.

scenes.title: More personality
scenes.say: The Air 2 has a customizable expression display, AI noise cancellation for clearer calls, and seventy seven store reviews.

scenes.title: Check your floors
scenes.say: Heads up. Both only cross six millimeter obstacles, so thick rugs are a problem. Returns within fourteen days cost you the shipping, and the warranty is one year.

scenes.title:
Best value → SE‑2
More features → Air‑2
